Either way, for crushed velvet pile: hover a steamer (or a kettle's steam) an inch or two above the flat spot without touching the fabric, then gently brush the nap back up with a soft brush or a clean toothbrush while it's still damp — works on most polyester velvets, just spot-test somewhere hidden first.
